title: Taupo Hot Pools Guide for Families — AC Baths vs Thermal Explorer Highway
meta_desc: Discover the best Taupo hot pools for families, including prices and facilities
intro: Taupo is a haven for families seeking a relaxing getaway, with numerous hot pools to choose from. The AC Baths and Thermal Explorer Highway are two popular options, but which one is best for your family? With prices starting from $10 per adult, you can enjoy a soothing soak without breaking the bank.

sections.heading: AC Baths Taupo
sections.body: The AC Baths are a popular choice among families, offering a range of thermal pools, a water playground, and a dedicated area for toddlers. With prices starting from $10 per adult and $6 per child, it's an affordable option for a fun-filled day out.

sections.heading: Thermal Explorer Highway
list: Wairakei Terraces: $25 per adult, $15 per child
Craters of the Moon: $10 per adult, $5 per child
Orakei Korako: $39 per adult, $20 per child

rows: Thermal pools, water playground, toddler area
Thermal pools, walking trails, scenic views

sections.heading: Free and Low-Cost Options
sections.body: If you're on a tight budget, consider visiting the Otumuheke Stream, a free natural hot spring located near the Spa Thermal Park. Alternatively, the Taupo DeBretts Hot Springs offer a more affordable option, with prices starting from $15 per adult.

sections.heading: Getting There
sections.body: Taupo is approximately a 3-hour drive from Auckland, and 1-hour drive from Rotorua. The AC Baths and Thermal Explorer Highway are both easily accessible by car, with parking available on site.
